root_cause_hypothesis: Case PASSED on all scored dimensions (build 0 errors on a full build, xppbp 0 warnings/0 errors on the class, golden self-match). The run nevertheless surfaced two validate_code(mode="references") false positives worth fixing. (1) TOOL_DEFECT/KNOWLEDGE_GAP: AccessType and MenuItemType are kernel enums with no AxEnum XML anywhere under PackagesLocalDirectory, but they are absent from the ENTRIES list in src/knowledge/kernelEnums.ts. The X++ resolver therefore reports AccessType::View and MenuItemType::Display as hard unknown-static-member ERRORS under "Fix all errors before writing", and get_object_info(objectType="enum") answers "not found via bridge, symbol index, or on disk" and advises update_symbol_index on a file that cannot exist - precisely the "loop with no exit" the kernelEnums.ts docstring says the module exists to prevent. Both calls compile clean (xppc-verified this run and in the prior SecurityChecks probe). Under GROUNDING_ENFORCE=true this would have BLOCKED the write of correct code; here the gate was off so it was only misleading. (2) Lower severity: gateOnReferenceErrors/resolveXppReferences have no exemption for the object being created, so an ordinary in-class static call written as ClassName::method() - the only spelling X++ accepts, since a bare name resolves only to predefined function, Global static, or local function - is reported as unknown-type until after the write.
suggested_fix_area: src/knowledge/kernelEnums.ts (add AccessType and MenuItemType to ENTRIES, with the value names shipped code uses, and re-audit the remaining ~44 index-unresolvable enum names against the AxEnum basename set); secondarily src/tools/write/resolveReferences.ts (pass the object name being created into resolveXppReferences so self-qualified static calls are not reported as unknown-type).
